parts.title: A Big Plan
parts.text: Lola, Andre, and Sana wanted to plan a **surprise** party for their friend Mia. “It has to be a **secret**,” whispered Lola. Andre drew a bright **invitation** with stars on it, and Sana handed one to every classmate.

parts.title: Getting Ready
parts.text: On Saturday, everyone came early to **decorate** the backyard. Sana blew up a red **balloon** and tied it to the fence. Andre hung a long **banner** that said “Happy Birthday!” Lola taped a rainbow **streamer** across the doorway.

parts.title: The Big Moment
parts.text: When Mia walked in, everyone jumped out and shouted, “Happy birthday!” Her face filled with **delight**. Everyone began to **celebrate** with music and games. Lola lit the **candle** on the cake, and Mia made a wish. Then she began to **unwrap** her presents, and the whole yard felt **merry**.

parts.title: The Best Day
parts.text: Later, Mia hugged her three friends and said it was the best birthday ever. She said she had not guessed a thing. Lola, Andre, and Sana smiled. Planning a happy day for someone else felt wonderful, and they could not wait to do it again.
